item.title: ABC News: UK-Iranian national arrested over alleged terror incident at British air base
item.description: UK police arrested the 27-year-old in London on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts and said a second British man, 26, had also been questioned under caution.

item.title: ABC News: Renee Good's family sues Trump administration over fatal Minneapolis shooting
item.description: Ms Good was one of two people shot dead by ICE agents during a mass immigration sweep in the US city of Minneapolis, that intensified opposition to Donald Trump's migration policies.

item.title: ABC News: School and nuclear facility hit in latest wave of Russian strikes
item.description: Ukraine has been bombarded with high-speed 'jet-powered' attack drones, with a nuclear facility and a school among the latest Russian targets.

item.title: ABC News: Labor will go after lawyers trying to 'game' the visa system
item.description: Labor is moving against lawyers and migration agents accused of profiting from visa applications that have little prospect of success.

item.title: ABC News: War criminal Biljana Plavsic, dubbed Serbia's 'Iron Lady', dies aged 96
item.description: Plavsic pleaded guilty at a United Nations tribunal to persecution as a crime against humanity for her role in atrocities during the 1992-95 Bosnian war.

item.title: ABC News: Heeney wins Sydney Swans best and fairest award amid club suspension
item.description: An absent Isaac Heeney claims the Bob Skilton Medal for a third season in a row following a club imposed suspension for a breach of standards.

item.title: ABC News: Netanyahu claims flydubai pilot underwent 'radical indoctrination'
item.description: UAE, meanwhile, says it will investigate the circumstances and motives, of the incident, including whether it was linked ​to ‌any militant activity.

item.title: ABC News: WA police ban 'excluded persons' from protesting at defence expo
item.description: New legislation passed last month gives WA police additional temporary powers to manage next week's Land Forces event, and at least six people have already received letters banning them from protesting inside the security zone.

item.title: ABC News: 'It's coming for everything': Eddie Perfect on AI and his new satire
item.description: Writer and actor Eddie Perfect's next show is a black comedy based on Molière's Tartuffe that replaces the 17th-century play's quasi-religious charlatan with an AI hairdressing robot.

item.title: ABC News: Former union delegate and bikie fined $2,000 over illegal debt collection
item.description: Victorian prosecutors have dropped a blackmail charge against a former CFMEU delegate with links to criminal bikie gangs.

item.title: ABC News: Perth's western suburbs councils take steps toward merger
item.description: The Town of Claremont in Perth's western suburbs is open to exploring merging with another council, with its mayor saying "it is probably time" for the move.

item.title: ABC News: Why Malaysia is deporting thousands of Myanmar asylum seekers
item.description: Malaysia this week deported about 1,500 Myanmar nationals, including children, as part of a refugee repatriation programme.

item.title: ABC News: Safety team hits Hobart CBD amid reports of youths 'causing havoc'
item.description: Safety officers serving as "eyes and ears" in Hobart's CBD are hoping their patrols will help curb antisocial behaviour.

item.title: ABC News: The last thing Albanese needed was free advice from his own side
item.description: Under pressure from opponents after another interest rate hike and more bad inflation news, the last thing Anthony Albanese needed was free advice from his own side.

item.title: ABC News: Brumby advocate challenges legality of wild horse removal in NSW alps
item.description: The shooting has stopped for now, but a brumby advocate is mounting a legal challenge to ban their removal from Kosciuszko National Park.

item.title: ABC News: 'Where illegal e-bikes go to die': Compliance crackdown ramps up
item.description: A number of illegal e-bikes were destroyed and turned into scrap metal at a wrecking facility in Western Sydney.
